practice.website_identity: patient-facing practice microsite hosted on the GTD domain; no separate live public practice domain found during this pass

investigation.method: manual review of live practice pages with NHS profile and search-result cross-checks

headline: Gordon Street looks like a GTD Concrete CMS site with PATCHS as the current online consultation front door. Unlike New Bank, the NHS App instructions also point to PATCHS rather than Accurx, but the page still overstates phone/in-person as if they were separate access systems.

live_stack.label: Patient-facing website stack
live_stack.platform: GTD-hosted practice microsite on concrete5 / Concrete CMS
evidence: The page exposes a concrete5 - 8.5.1 generator tag.
Search and NHS-profile checks did not surface a separate live practice domain; this GTD URL appears to be the patient-facing microsite.

live_stack.label: Current online request platform
evidence: The appointments page tells NHS App users to continue to Patchs Health.

current_routes.label: PATCHS direct route
notes: The page presents PATCHS as the online request form for appointments.
It says all requests go through Patchs.

current_routes.label: NHS App route
notes: The site tells NHS App users to continue to Patchs Health.

current_routes.label: Phone route
current_routes.kind: staff-assisted intake, not a distinct digital platform
notes: The website lists phoning the practice as one of three ways to request an appointment.
The same page also says all requests go through Patchs and that staff will do it for patients who call or visit.

current_routes.label: Prescriptions
notes: The prescriptions page points patients to their NHS account or to the practice email address gmicb-tameside.gordonstreetmedicalcentre@nhs.net.

complaints_and_feedback.headline: Complaints information is present on the contact-us page.

items.label: Complaints via contact-us page
notes: The page says patients should raise concerns with the practice manager first or contact the complaints team directly.
It lists practice and GTD complaints contact details, including gtd.feedback@nhs.net.

stale_or_conflicting_signals.label: Malformed GTD links in page markup
notes: The appointments and contact-us pages contain malformed URLs with embedded <em> tags in some GTD links.
Those links should not be trusted without clicking them directly in a browser.

stale_or_conflicting_signals.label: Phone and visit wording
notes: The page lists phone and visit as ways to request appointments, but the surrounding text still frames PATCHS as the underlying workflow.

probably_true: PATCHS is the current patient-facing request platform here.
Phone and in-person should be treated as staff-assisted intake into the same workflow, not separate front doors.
needs_follow_up: Whether any of the malformed GTD links break important patient guidance in practice.
